questions.q: Why did the Most High call Isaac Abraham's 'only son' when Ishmael was alive?
choices: Isaac was the child of the promise; Ishmael was born of the flesh
questions.explain: Ishmael came of a plan the Lord never spoke; Isaac was the child of the promise.

questions.q: How is the fear of God proved, according to the class?
questions.explain: They that fear the Lord will not disobey His word (Ecclesiasticus 2:15). Now I know that thou fearest God.

questions.q: What did Abraham account that God was able to do with Isaac?
choices: Raise him up, even from the dead
questions.explain: By faith Abraham offered up Isaac (Hebrews 11:17-19). Faith and the commandments go together.

questions.q: What did God provide in the stead of Isaac?
choices: A ram caught in a thicket by his horns
questions.explain: Abraham called the place Jehovahjireh: in the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.

questions.q: What does 'thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies' show about the covenant?
choices: Israel possesses its enemies, so all nations cannot be inside this covenant
All nations share the land equally
questions.explain: The seed of Jacob shall possess the remnant of Edom and of all the heathen (Amos 9:11-12; Numbers 24:17-18).
